title: Brazilian Idioms & Expressions
description: Common Brazilian idioms with practical meanings and natural examples.

cards.en: to mess up; drop the ball

example.pt: Ele pisou na bola ao esquecer a reunião.
example.en: He dropped the ball by forgetting the meeting.

cards.en: to help out; improvise a fix

example.en: This adapter helps in a pinch.

example.pt: O aplicativo foi uma mão na roda na viagem.
example.en: The app was a big help on the trip.

cards.en: to give up restraint; throw it all away

example.pt: Depois de tanta pressão, ele chutou o balde.
example.en: After so much pressure, he threw it all away.

example.pt: A diretora não quis ficar em cima do muro.
example.en: The director did not want to sit on the fence.

example.pt: Só depois caiu a ficha do que aconteceu.
example.en: Only later did what happened sink in.

cards.en: to pad; fill space with fluff

example.pt: O aluno encheu linguiça na redação.
Ela segurou a onda durante a crise.
example.en: She handled the pressure during the crisis.
